text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Even though it was my last race of the 
year, 
I ended up with such a pathetic result...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Even though there were people cheering 
for me...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(...Why does anyone even cheer for someone 
like me...? 
I can't put on a good show, I'm not 
friendly or charming... There's nothing 
rewarding about rooting for me...)
Cheval-chiii!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Wh-What is it, Vivlos...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~ You looked totally down in the 
dumps, so I got curious☆ 
Anyway, did you check your phone?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
It's a broadcast email from the academy. 
They're holding a "New Year's Countdown 
Party."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Let's all go! Head back to the academy 
early! 
An all-night festival with a countdown is 
gonna be so much fun~!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
It's a rare opportunity to ring in the new 
year together with our fans. 
I'm sure everyone will be thrilled.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Of course you're joining too, Cheval-chi, 
right? 
Missing out on a special event like this 
would be such a waste!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(...I still haven't... 
given anything back to the people who 
cheered for me...)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Cheval?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... N-No, it's fine. 
...I'll go too. To the countdown party.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yay~! It's settled, then! 
Let's get ready right away! Time to prep~♪

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Right now... that's the only way 
I can give anything back to my fans...)

text_block_list.name: Townsperson A
text_block_list.text:
Did you hear? Tracen Academy's doing a 
countdown at the end of the year! 
Stalls, stage shows, and even a live 
concert!

text_block_list.name: Townsperson B
text_block_list.text:
We totally have to go! 
Ringing in the new year with Umamusume is 
nothing but good fortune!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh? Dura-san!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Weren't you two heading back to your 
hometowns—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes, but we changed our plans and came 
back early! 
We heard there was going to be a festival 
at the academy!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
My family wanted to try spending New 
Year's Eve at the academy too. 
It sounds so exciting, doesn't it? The 
countdown party!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Friends, family, and the fans too! 
I want to have fun with everyone, and make 
sure everyone has a blast!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Dura-san, is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
No... With you two around, the festival is 
sure to be lively.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's our festival-loving Kita-chan 
for you. 
Wherever she goes, the atmosphere lights 
right up and gets so cheerful.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I might just be easily carried 
away, 
but I really love seeing everyone smile.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Well, Dura-san, we're heading back to the 
academy now.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Right.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ..."Make sure everyone has a blast"...

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Man, what a truly big-hearted person! 
Even though we were late for the 
interview, he graciously agreed to do 
it...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you must be—Duramente-chan! Your 
father is simply wonderful, 
not just as an athlete, but in how 
generous he is with his fans!

text_block_list.name: Young Dura
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, he is an incredible father.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(...Am I living up to that standard? 
Like my father, and my grandfathers—)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's only been a few days, but coming back 
to the dorm 
really gives you that "I'm home~" feeling, 
doesn't it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Whoa...! Duramente-san...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What an intense aura...!? 
What happened!? You're not... mad, are 
you...!?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I, too... wish to execute "fan 
service"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon receiving news of the countdown 
party, 
the Umamusume began returning from their 
hometowns one by one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the academy during winter break 
grew ever livelier as the end of the year 
approached.
